recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見大型組織球有豐富淡粉紅細胞質與泡狀圓核、單一清楚核仁，中央一顆組織球內包著數個完整淋巴球（emperipolesis），背景有淋巴球與漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman disease。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely granular to vacuolated cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with a single distinct nucleolus (e.g. upper left center)
Emperipolesis of several intact lymphocytes within a central histiocyte, with halos around engulfed cells
Scattered plasma cells, small lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils in the background
Loose, dyscohesive tissue with clear spaces and focal red cells
describe_en: High-power sections show numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. A central histiocyte contains multiple intact lymphocytes within its cytoplasm (emperipolesis), and other histiocytes show similar engulfed cells. The background contains small lymphocytes, plasma cells and scattered neutrophils without atypical large lymphoid cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells have grooved, folded nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a and langerin, without emperipolesis.
Hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei, marked atypia and strong CD30/ALK positivity rather than bland vesicular histiocyte nuclei.
Shows marked nuclear pleomorphism, mitoses and necrosis, with at most focal emperipolesis and weak or absent S100.
Histiocytes are smaller and S100 negative and lack prominent engulfed lymphocytes.
